package.name: Wordle
package.description: A daily Wordle race with Conversation characters. Install to use /wordle manually in any Conversation chat, or type a message like "let's play wordle" to open today's game. Where Chat Settings → Agents → Commands lists Wordle, characters can start today's game while its switch is on.
